ideas.pitch: An ElevenLabs-powered voice assistant trained on space mission logs and telemetry data, allowing crew members to query ship diagnostics and execute commands hands-free.
ideas.title: AstroVoice Mission Control
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly integrates ElevenLabs as the core sponsor technology, making it a top contender for sponsor-backed judging criteria.

ideas.pitch: A space-themed predictive analytics dashboard that forecasts space debris collision risks using regression models and real-time orbital telemetry.
ideas.title: Singularity Orbital Risk Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a complex mathematical forecasting problem similar to winning data science projects, appealing to technical judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring platform that detects structural anomalies in industrial space hardware and spaceports.
ideas.title: Nebula Nav - AI Satellite Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the space theme of the hackathon while tackling hard computer vision engineering tasks.

ideas.pitch: An ElevenLabs-integrated audio intelligence platform that converts chaotic deep-space voice logs into searchable, structured mission summaries.
ideas.title: Cosmic Crew Audio Log Summarizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages ElevenLabs voice capabilities combined with data processing to appeal directly to the primary sponsor's ecosystem.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered biometric health monitoring companion designed for astronauts on long-duration space missions, built entirely by a first-time hackathon team.
ideas.title: Starlight Shield Health Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Best Girls Team or Best Freshers team track with a polished, scoped MVP that solves a relatable astronaut health problem.
